# Emily's Game — Copilot / coding-agent instructions

**Superseded freeze repealed 2026-08-13.**

Current law is root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Living recovered design
is [`docs/intent/`](../docs/intent/README.md).

This file used to restate: stay on `experiment/isometric-2.0`, Iso2 paint
only, FOV 128×64 locked, do not reopen closed campaigns, surgical edits
only, GameMan default. **Those rules are repealed.** Do not re-teach them.

## What you do now

1. Treat `Docs/`, `memories/`, archives, and `.github/instructions/` as
   **historical**. Scavenge intent. Do not obey their “no rewrite” framing.
2. Treat shipped `src/` as **untrusted**. Do not extend it as the default.
   First campaign is full-fidelity intent recovery into `docs/intent/`.
3. Do not carry old code or pseudocode into the recovered design.
4. Rewrite, when opened, happens on `rewrite/intent-first` (or successor)
   from recovered intent — not by porting the current tree.
5. Path files in `.github/instructions/` and personas in `.github/agents/`
   are superseded. If they load, defer to `AGENTS.md`.
6. AmysGame is independent. This repo is still Emily’s Game.

## Autonomy

Keep working until the user’s request is done. Do not stop after one
search to “report status.” Do not ask permission to read the next
archive. Ask only when two recovered intents contradict and the owner
must pick.
